description: I am an individual participant passionate about space exploration, scientific research, programming, and innovation. I am developing SpaceGrow, a project focused on sustainable plant growth in Martian environments. My interests include space science, AI, software development, and environmental sustainability. My goal is to create innovative solutions that support future space exploration.
summary: SpaceGrow is an interactive Digital Twin and mission training simulator designed to train astronauts and space researchers on cultivating sustainable crops on Mars and harsh Earth analog environments. Cultivating food in space is challenging due to extreme temperatures, cosmic radiation, and scarce water. SpaceGrow solves this by providing a safe, mobile-first simulation lab where trainees adjust environmental parameters—such as water supply, radiation shielding, temperature, and CO2—to monitor their immediate impact on Lettuce (Lactuca sativa) growth. It also serves as a practical precision-agriculture training tool for cultivating arid deserts on Earth, such as Egypt's Western Desert.
